name: Map Object Field
description: A field that lets editors draw shapes on a map (Google Maps supported).
project_description:
Module provides the field which allows editors to draw shapes(circles, lines, polygons, polylines, markers, rectangles) on Maps. Current version supports Google maps, but more map providers(Yandex, OSM) can be added in future.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 New field type "map_object_field" 
 Configurable widget, you can configure types and number of objects available for drawing. 
 Configurable formatter, admin can define width and height of displayed map. 
 Every drawn shape has title and description which are displayed inside infowindow on click event(see screenshot). 
 Editors can define fill and stroke colors for the shape 
 
 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 Drupal 8.3

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. See: https://www.drupal.org/documentation/install/modules-themes/modules-8 for further information.

 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 
 Get Google Map API key( https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/get-api-key ),then visit /admin/configuration/map-object-field and set the key. More info: ( https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/usage ) 
 Don't forget to add your domains to google maps API "white list" for this key 
 Attach field to any entity 
 Configure field widget 
 Configure field formatter 
 Back to top
